name: Peeling or Flaking Floor Finish in Seattle: Why It Happens
title-tag: Peeling or Flaking Floor Finish: Why It Happens | Seattle
meta-description: Peeling floor finish means it never bonded: contamination, skipped abrasion, or moisture. A Seattle contractor explains the diagnosis and the honest fix.
post-summary: January 13, 2027 · Finish that peels was doomed before it dried — it either bonds on day one or never does. The four causes we find in Seattle homes (wax and polish contamination, skipped abrasion, incompatible layers, crawlspace moisture), how to read the flake, and when a $1.99 recoat can still save the floor.
